no-agent-worktrees-tracked.patterns_source: This repo's .gitignore line 45 ignores all of .claude/, which is where its harness places worktrees — there is a live one at .claude/worktrees/agent-aa23a70e43fabef2c right now. Bare .claude is not used as a pattern: the check tests trackedness, and the narrower path is the one the convention names.

stale-worktrees.mode_reason: Report-only is required by the check itself, and is right here: a stale linked worktree is housekeeping, not a competitive or security defect. Blocking a commit on it would put a cleanup task in the path of a round-resolution fix.
stale-worktrees.fast_reason: Excluded from the pre-commit subset. It walks every linked worktree and asks git whether each is dirty or unpushed, which is per-worktree process work; the fast subset exists so the hook stays usable.
stale-worktrees.max_age_reason: One week gives a linked worktree time to be integrated or deliberately handed off before it becomes a finding. This repository has produced agent worktrees that outlived their task -- one was found holding a superseded Stage 1 commit and had to be removed before the V2-048 history rewrite could run.
stale-worktrees.age_source: The linked worktree directory mtime. Named explicitly because it is not commit age: a worktree can hold old commits and still have been touched today, and the reverse.
stale-worktrees.include_main_reason: The primary checkout is the active workspace this handoff is built in, not a stranded worktree. It is still listed and its state reported, so excluding it hides nothing.
